title: Version-stamped capability ledger
body: decision/capability-ledger · Version-stamped capability ledger — Any behaviour of the `claude` CLI that viola relies on is a row in a version-stamped capability ledger; a CLI version is verified only when its stamp holds every relied ledger row `pass`, and `viola verify` re-stamps it. · why: The docs lag the installed build, and several load-bearing behaviours are measured, not documented. · except: StopFailure is registered with no ledger row and no verify probe.
